Technical Specifications

The Antec GSK850 is a high-performance, fully modular power supply unit (PSU) designed for gaming enthusiasts and professionals who require stable and efficient power delivery.

FeatureSpecification
ModelAntec GSK850
Maximum Power850 Watts
Efficiency Rating80 PLUS® Gold (Up to 92% efficiency)
ModularityFully Modular (Flat black cables)
TypeIntel ATX 12V 2.4
Fan Type120mm FDB (Fluid Dynamic Bearing) Silent Fan
TopologyPhase Shift Full-Bridge LLC design with DC-to-DC
CapacitorsHigh-quality Japanese capacitors for stability
